text: This is a jet engine, cut open so we can see inside it.
Air is pulled in at the front by a big spinning fan.
Compressor blades squeeze the air, packing it tighter and hotter.
Fuel burns in the combustor, making hot gas that expands fast.
That hot gas spins the turbine, which turns the fan and compressor on the same shaft.
The gas leaves out the back, and the engine is pushed forward. That push is thrust.
